commitResults.messageBody: Include the skill instructions, interface metadata, and standard-library generator so future repository changes can be reviewed in a self-contained split-view HTML page.
Track completion status for stored tasks and support the mark command. Display task status icons in list output and confirm which task was marked complete.

Task handling is split between parallel arrays and command logic, and the Java classes are in the default package.

Let's store each task as a Task object and keep its completion state with the task. Move the classes into the bigbrother package and align the code with the project's SE-EDU Java standard.

This preserves add, list, mark, and unmark behavior while improving encapsulation and maintainability.

AGENTS.md has incomplete student profile placeholders and lacks mandatory project coding and Git standards.

Set the student profile details and mandate the SE-EDU Java and Git conventions through the project-specific skills.

This keeps future agent assistance aligned with the project's coding and commit requirements.

CLAUDE.md does not explicitly identify the project's required Java and Git standards.

Document the SE-EDU Java and Git checklists and point agents to their project-specific skills.

This makes the standards visible when agents load CLAUDE.md directly.

Agent guidance references project-local Java and Git standards, but the
skill files are not tracked.

Add both standard skills and update the README run path for the packaged
Java entry point so the documented setup matches the project.
Parse deadline commands and display their due dates consistently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add todo and event task support
commitResults.messageBody: Support typed todo and event commands with formatted output. Validate malformed input to prevent command parsing crashes.
